entries.title: Psalms 63:1
segments: ¶<A Psalm. Of David. When he was in the waste land of Judah.> O God, you are my God; early will I make my search for you: my soul is dry for need of you, my flesh is wasted with desire for you, as a dry and burning land where no water is;

entries.title: Psalms 63:2
segments: To see your power and your glory, as I have seen you in the holy place.

entries.title: Psalms 63:3
segments: ¶Because your mercy is better than life, my lips will give you praise.

entries.title: Psalms 63:4
segments: So will I go on blessing you all my life, lifting up my hands in your name.

entries.title: Psalms 63:5
segments: My soul will be comforted, as with good food; and my mouth will give you praise with songs of joy;

entries.title: Psalms 63:6
segments: When the memory of you comes to me on my bed, and when I give thought to you in the night-time.

entries.title: Psalms 63:7
segments: ¶Because you have been my help, I will have joy in the shade of your wings.

entries.title: Psalms 63:8
segments: My soul keeps ever near you: your right hand is my support.

entries.title: Psalms 63:9
segments: But those whose desire is my soul's destruction will go down to the lower parts of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 63:10
segments: They will be cut off by the sword; they will be food for foxes.

entries.title: Psalms 63:11
segments: But the king will have joy in God; everyone who takes an oath by him will have cause for pride; but the false mouth will be stopped.
